scheme_name: Financial Assistance Scheme for Purchase of Agricultural Land to Scheduled Caste Farmers
other_conditions: The applicant must be a native of Gujarat.
Only one member of the family is eligible for the benefit.
Beneficiaries of land acquired with government assistance cannot sell the land for 15 years.
The applicant must be able to purchase the land (excluding government assistance).
benefits_summary: Provides up to ₹2,00,000 financial assistance (₹1,00,000 per acre) for purchase of up to 2 acres of agricultural land for Scheduled Caste farmers.
